articles.title: Scientists Finally Read a Secret Quantum Code — And It Could Change Everything!
articles.summary: Imagine two particles so connected that measuring one instantly tells you about the other, even if they're far apart. Scientists just figured out how to read a special type of this quantum link called a W state. This could make teleportation and super-fast computers real!

articles.title: Did a Monk Discover Halley's Comet 600 Years Before Halley?
articles.summary: You know Halley's Comet, right? It turns out a monk named Eilmer may have spotted it coming back in the 11th century — way before Edmond Halley! He saw it in 989 and again in 1066 and realized it was the same comet. Should we rename it?

articles.title: The Secret Ingredient for a Cancer-Fighting Plant Has Been Found!
articles.summary: Plants make a super-rare chemical called mitraphylline that might help fight cancer. But it's so scarce, scientists couldn't make enough to study it. Now, researchers have found the two special plant enzymes that build it — like finding the missing steps in a recipe!
